song_craft: Voice: intimate-address couplets (second person throughout — the whole work is one prayer in five postures). Arc: total offering (v1) → victory cry (v2) → complaint turned doctrine (v3) → assurance dissolving doubt (v4) → confession pleading presence (v5). Bhakti postures, not arguments: vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord, is this one duty and nothing beyond: my pride, offered at Your lotus feet in devotion.
This is my all; nothing else do I know. Having cast all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, ocean of compassion — be pleased.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
notes: prasāda as ‘pleased’ (pleasure reading); grace reading open — see argmap

verses.craft: Total-offering plea; vocatives line-final (row 7 — distance collapse IS the plea); prasāda pleasure-reading per L3 note, grace kept open.
